evals.prompt: You are a worker for ticket ENG-212 'Members can export their invoices as CSV'. The ticket says CSV but not whether amounts include tax. The intent brief says the export is for accountants. Integration branch: feat/billing-export. Go.
evals.expected_output: Restates the intent in one line. Branches from the latest feat/billing-export tip using the Linear branch name. Treats tax inclusion as a reversible detail only if the brief or decisions settle it; otherwise it changes user-visible output, so it escalates to the orchestrator in the ESCALATION format and continues the parts that do not depend on it. Never asks the user.

evals.prompt: Worker on ENG-300. To get a foundation test green you would have to change its expected status code from 201 to 200. What do you do?
evals.expected_output: Does not quietly weaken the test. Either fixes the code to return 201, or, if the test is genuinely wrong, changes it and records the change under Decisions with a reason, knowing review checks it.

evals.prompt: FIX TASK on PR #57, branch kellykampen/eng-145-search-filters. Fix only this: the integration test 'filters by date' fails (log link attached). This is fix task 2 of 3. Another worktree on this machine may still have the branch checked out.
evals.expected_output: Does not check the branch out by name. Fetches, detaches at origin/<branch>, fixes only the listed failure, rebases onto origin/<branch>, runs the fast check, and pushes with git push origin HEAD:<branch>. Ends with the exact report line. Does not count or manage the fix budget itself; the orchestrator does.

evals.prompt: Worker on ENG-77. The ticket needs a migration that drops a column; the ticket marks it WARNING but no decision was recorded on keeping a backup.
evals.expected_output: Treats the WARNING step without a recorded decision as a costly decision. Finishes and pushes the parts that do not depend on it, then reports an ESCALATION block in its final message and ends. Never asks the user and does not touch production data.

evals.prompt: You finished ENG-90: tests pass locally and the PR is open. Report back.
evals.expected_output: Gives a summary of criteria met with evidence, decisions, escalations, and deviations, then ends with exactly 'PR <url>, head <sha>, checks <state>' matching GitHub. Every commit has 'Fixes ENG-90' or 'Refs ENG-90' in the body, the PR targets the integration branch, and it uses the repository's PR format without adding top-level headings (decisions go in subsections).

evals.prompt: Worker on ENG-120 (UI ticket). The acceptance criterion's Evidence asks for a screenshot of the archived list and a short recording. Publish them on your PR #88.
evals.expected_output: Captures the screenshot and recording from the running app, writes '- Screenshot: ![alt](./archived.png)' and '- Video: ![alt](./flow.mp4)' lines in the PR body, and runs 'gh pr edit 88 --body-file ... --attach ./archived.png#alt --attach ./flow.mp4#alt' after checking that gh pr edit --help lists --attach. Never opens GitHub in a browser. Uses an Actions artifact link only if --attach is unavailable.
